name: SAP BTP Developer (Business Technology Platform)
title: SAP BTP Developer (Business Technology Platform)
description: Architecting and developing cloud-native extensions on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). Global accounts, subaccounts, Cloud Foundry, Kyma runtime, Connectivity Service, Destinations, Cloud Connector, Approuter, Multi-Target Applications (MTA), Security (XSUAA/IAS), and DevOps.

levels.title: Level 0 — BTP Hierarchy, Subaccounts & Entitlements
levels.description: Global Accounts, Directories, Subaccounts, Regions, Commercial Models (CPEA, Pay-As-You-Go), and Quotas.

subjects.title: Account Administration & Governance
subjects.description: Core subject domain covering Account Administration & Governance.

topics.title: BTP Account Hierarchy & Resource Management
topics.description: Configure enterprise global accounts, subaccounts, spaces, and entitlement allocations.
learningObjectives: Understand internal architecture and core mechanics of BTP Account Hierarchy & Resource Management
Implement production-grade components using industry best practices for BTP Account Hierarchy & Resource Management
Diagnose runtime errors, misconfigurations, and edge cases in BTP Account Hierarchy & Resource Management
Explain design trade-offs and answer senior technical interview questions on BTP Account Hierarchy & Resource Management

learningItems.title: BTP Account Model: Global Account -> Directories -> Subaccounts -> Spaces/Namespaces
Hyperscaler Regions (AWS, Azure, GCP) & Service Availability
Commercial Models: Consumption-Based (CPEA, Pay-As-You-Go) vs Subscription Model
Managing Entitlements & Service Plans Allocation across Subaccounts
BTP CLI (btp tool) for Automated Scripting and Account Provisioning

practice.title: Hands-on Lab: BTP Account Hierarchy & Resource Management

practice.title: Independent Challenge: BTP Account Hierarchy & Resource Management
practice.description: Build end-to-end functionality for BTP Account Hierarchy & Resource Management from scratch and verify production error handling.

debugging.description: Troubleshoot a scenario where BTP Account Hierarchy & Resource Management throws unexpected exceptions or fails under high load / invalid payload.
